_source: Extracted from AMB's own workbooks (AMB + Topkey - Diligence Workbook v51.xlsx, AMB + Topkey - Valuation & Offer Structure.xlsx, AMB + Sunshine Commercial - Diligence Workbook v7.xlsx). See docs/research/amb-models.md for context. 'observed' = what AMB does today; 'recommended' = proposed fix for the new templates.

recommended.note: Write the font name as exactly 'Arial'. v51 contains 18,503 cells set to 'arial' (lower case) and 5,590 set to 'Arail' (typo, so it falls back to the default font).

colors.chartSecondarySeries: 70AD47 (Office theme accent 6, used for client wins vs. 7B0000 losses)
colors.chartLineSeries: 00B0F0 (thin line for '% of recurring revenue' over the bars)

fontColorCoding.printToggle: Each sheet has a 'Print' label with a 0/1 input cell (blue, boxed) near row 3. A conditional format tied to it turns every coloured font black for client-ready PDFs.

numberFormats.units: $000s everywhere except client/fee-level tabs, which use ($) or (#, $); the unit is stated in the sheet subtitle

layout.subtitleRow: B3 = '<Sheet purpose> ($000s)', Arial 9 italic, thin bottom border across the print width
layout.headerRows: rows 5-6: two-tier header. Tier 1 = period group ('Full Year', 'YTD', 'LTM', 'PF', 'PF Delta') centred across the group; tier 2 = the period label. Both 7B0000 fill, white bold 9pt
layout.sectionRow: bold label ('Revenue', 'Expenses', 'P&L Adjustments'), FFE1E1 fill across each column group, not across spacer columns
layout.subtotal: bold, thin top border, no fill
layout.keyTotal: bold, FFFFCC fill, thin box border around each column group; '% Margin' row below in bold italic
layout.printSetup: print area B2:<last col><last row>, fit to page; portrait for statements, landscape for monthly grids and the cover
